proposals.evidence: DEDR 4411 connects Tamil periya/peritu, Telugu pedda, Gondi beriya, Konda per/peri, Parji berto and Gadaba berit big. These language-matched survey stems fit that family; the numerous valiya, doḍḍa and Indo-Aryan-looking alternatives are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
